topic: Myth: My teen needs to focus only on school
caption:
School matters. So does knowing how to show up, follow through, and earn.

Teens who run a small side hustle even 3-4 hours a week often develop better time management than those who don't.

The skills stack. The grades don't suffer. The confidence grows.
